시편 44:1.content: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil. We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

시편 44:2.content: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

시편 44:3.content: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

시편 44:4.content: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

시편 44:5.content: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

시편 44:6.content: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

시편 44:7.content: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

시편 44:8.content: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

시편 44:9.content: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

시편 44:10.content: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

시편 44:11.content: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

시편 44:12.content: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase thy wealth by their price.

시편 44:13.content: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

시편 44:14.content: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

시편 44:15.content: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

시편 44:16.content: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

시편 44:17.content: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

시편 44:18.content: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

시편 44:19.content: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

시편 44:20.content: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

시편 44:21.content: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

시편 44:22.content: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

시편 44:23.content: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast us not off for ever.

시편 44:24.content: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

시편 44:25.content: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

시편 44:26.content: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.
